newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent inches higher on charts, gas oil steady.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent inches higher on charts, gas oil steady.

text.p: IPE Brent futures were a touch firmer in early trade as the market picked up on some buy signals and drew strength from firmness on NYMEX, dealers said.
July Brent was five cents higher at $17.83 a barrel by 1000 GMT. August gas oil was unchanged at $159.50 a tonne.
In a market driven largely by technicals, brokers said buying kicked in late on Thursday when Brent trickled down towards a buy signal at $17.72 and the resultant upturn had carried into Friday.
Further support came from NYMEX which ticked up seven cents to $18.74 a barrel on ACCESS.
Brokers said Brent was stuck in a tight range between $17.72 and $17.96 a barrel which it has been confined to for the past two days.
But a break from that range could spark a more major move, with players relieved to break from the shackles of current levels.
"I can see the market will get a bit bored with these levels and you've got a risk of any move out of the range being big and violent," one broker said.
The expiry of the NYMEX July contract at the close on Friday was seen as a possible catalyst of a move.
Trade in gas oil was thin and the levels unchanged, though dealers said the market looked negative below key support at $160.00.
